name: classes_declared
note: of those, carrying at least one declaration

name: declarations
note: declarations the grammar's rule reads in the live text

name: bodies
note: of those, a body the brace walk resolves

name: stubs
note: of those, declaration-only: no body between the declaration and the next one

name: body_empty_braces
note: declarations whose body is an empty `{}`

name: body_empty
note: declarations with a body whose export is the empty script -- the control

name: body_empty_braces_empty
note: of the empty-script bodies, an empty `{}`

name: stub_semicolon
note: stubs with the declaration's `;` before any `{` -- a bodyless declaration

name: stub_class_export
note: stubs whose name the class itself exports as a `Function`

name: stub_scope_class
note: stubs at the class's own level

name: stub_empty
note: stubs whose export is the compiler's empty script -- the declaration was all there was

name: stub_empty_class
note: of the empty ones, the class's own export

name: stub_commented
note: stub windows holding a block comment

name: all_stub_classes
note: classes whose every declaration is a stub

name: half_stub_classes
note: classes with four or more declarations and at least half of them stubs

name: stub_state_export
note: stubs whose name only a `State` of the class exports

name: stub_scope_state
note: stubs written inside a `state` block -- they resolve to that state's own `Function` export

name: stub_empty_state
note: of the empty ones, a `State` of the class exports it

name: body_empty_braces_bodied
note: of those, carry a longer payload than the empty script

name: stub_redeclared
note: stubs whose name the same text declares again, with a body

name: body_empty_other
note: of the empty-script bodies, a body carrying no statements -- locals, comments or structure

name: stub_no_brace
note: stubs with no `{` in the window at all -- the body sits after an `#endif`

name: stub_bodied
note: stubs whose export carries a longer script -- a body the text lost

name: stub_bodied_class
note: of the bodied ones, the class's own export -- the body the text lost

name: largest_stub_payload
note: the largest payload behind a stub

name: stub_bodied_redeclared
note: of the bodied ones, the same text declares the name again with a body -- a forward declaration

name: stub_bodied_redeclared_back
note: of the bodied ones, an *earlier* declaration of the name carries the body -- a `State` member declared below the class's own body

name: stub_no_export
note: stubs naming no `Function` export of their class

name: stub_unbalanced
note: stubs whose braces never close -- a `ScriptText` that ends inside a body

name: stub_bodied_undeclared
note: of the bodied ones, no body anywhere in the live text -- the script the text does not spell

name: undeclared_no_block
note: of the undeclared ones, the class ships no block comment at all

name: packages
note: packages with at least one declaration

name: stub_names_all
note: distinct names behind every stub -- the join's denominator

name: stub_names_in_comments
note: of those, names the corpus also carries as a commented body -- the join's base rate

name: undeclared_distinct_names
note: distinct names behind the undeclared ones

name: bodied_distinct_payloads
note: distinct payloads behind the bodied stubs -- a repeated size is not a repeated script

name: bodied_shared_payload
note: of the bodied ones, a payload another of them carries
